title: Since 2019
body: I have used ShineDay since September 2019. I needed a habit tracker while back packing and trying to bring in a new era of myself by starting some good habits. I tried a LOT of tracker apps and this is quite simply the best I have ever found - by leaps. The more recent years’ updates have really elevate it even further. For me it is the visual nature of the way it tracks, the vibe that it’s about me as a human not as a work productively robot, and most importantly its simplicity. It is elegant in its ease of use and simplicity in all things. I whole heartedly recommend this app. The price listing makes it exceptional value, I’d easily have paid more for it.

title: SUPER cute wonderful app, but language issues :(
body:
shineday has literally everything i have ever wanted from a productivity app: cute design, habits separated into morning/afternoon/evening, adjustable daily routines AND non-habit tasks, a weekly/monthly view of habits, and did i mention the cute design? it even has features i didn't know i needed, like collecting sun points to redeem things from a wishlist.

i feel like there's so much more that i haven't even discovered in this cute little app, and i'm so eager to explore it that i'm willing to buy a subscription for an app for the first time ever. but there's one thing that makes me hesitate, and that's the slightly choppy translation for english. certain parts of the app are still in chinese even after switching to chinese. for example, the calendar, the arrows that switch from day to day in the 'TODAY' section, the location feature, etc.

this is such a tiny, nitpicky thing but it makes me hesitate to fully commit to the app. apart from that, it is literally *perfect* !!!

title: Fantastic App
body: I likely have ADHD and I really struggle with staying on task. Some people might be able to think of ‘get ready’ as one task but for me I have no idea which thing to do first. I get distracted easily and have 4 little ones so it’s always manic in the mornings. With this app I can have all the individual tasks I need to do on my widget screen, tap the one I’ve done and it disappears. It makes me feel so much more organised and on track. I love that I can name each task, choose an icon to represent it, change its colour and assign it to a specific section of the day. I have begun using Todoist for chores and general tasks that need doing but Tiny Routines is amazing for the specific steps of daily routines. Highly recommend!
